newlyInventoriedSources.sourceReview: Owns 500 deterministic record keys, All/Release/Alert/Empty filtering, public itemKeys updates, example button appearance and passive empty/status output. It obtains the public collection, delegates materialization/geometry to attachWebVirtualList, creates rows through viewport.ownerDocument, and removes listeners/disposes the host. The explicit scrollTop reset remains application composition. The two literal package imports are separately recorded by the merged PR #1844 import registry; this source-body audit does not establish runtime acceptance.

newlyInventoriedSources.sourceReview: Owns 1,000 deterministic keys and four public-button actions for start/center/end ensureVisible calls. Row highlighting and status output are application presentation; physical materialization stays with attachWebVirtualList. Listener cleanup, rowNodes.clear and host.dispose occur on teardown. The rowNodes map retains previously created entries during a live session, so the materialized-window cap is not proof of bounded application-retained nodes. The merged PR #1844 registry separately binds the two literal package imports; runtime acceptance remains outside this source-body audit.
